interpretation: A passing external UI driver is counted as an executed observer. Only the separate tap, target, role and file receipts establish a user scenario. Unqualified, failed and retried observations remain in the matrix.
countDefinition: Executed test methods across completed bundles, including repeats and red runs. A raw socket, an SSH store, an independent GUI driver and physical delivery are reported separately.
